product_summary: KLK OLEO is the oleochemical arm of Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad; the Indian entity (KLK OLEO India Pvt Ltd) is a manufacturer of oleochemicals derived from palm kernel and palm oil: fatty acids (lauric, myristic, palmitic, stearic, oleic), fatty alcohols (lauryl/myristyl/cetyl/stearyl), refined glycerine, soap noodles/soap base, methyl esters and fatty acid derivatives, plus specialty surfactants and personal-care/nutrition intermediates. NOTE ON EVIDENCE: the corporate site www.klkoleo.com returned only a bot-verification interstitial on every attempt (home, /products/, /about-us/, /india/, /products/oleochemicals/), klkoleoindia.com does not resolve, and IndiaMART returned HTTP 429. Web search was unavailable (searx connection refused). Therefore the product list above reflects the well-known KLK OLEO group oleochemical portfolio and is NOT corroborated by a page I could actually read in this session — treat it as 'заявлено, не подтверждено' pending a manual read of the catalogue.

comment: HS 340290 (other surface-active agents/washing preparations) is only a partial fit. It can cover part of the surfactant/specialty line, but the core oleochemical output of this company sits in Chapter 38 (3823 fatty acids), Chapter 29 (2915.70 stearic/palmitic acid, 2905.17 lauryl alcohol, 2905.45 glycerol) and Chapter 15 (1520 crude glycerol, 1516/1517 processed fats). So the declared single code 340290 understates and partly misplaces the range: status = partial, not wrong. Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground — company stays in the base and the code should be corrected/expanded to the actual lines. Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas + chemicals) is a misclassification on the 'oil & gas' half: this is oleochemicals/palm-oil downstream chemistry, not petroleum. No customs line was available to me in this session, so no HS code here is confirmed by a shipment record — all codes are 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Product lines likely missing from the declaration: fatty acids (3823/2915), fatty alcohols (2905.17), glycerine (1520/2905.45), soap noodles (3401), methyl esters. No registry, revenue or customs-volume research was performed per role scope.
